The *Ñāṇapaññāpañha* ("The Question on Intelligence and Wisdom", Mil 3.2.3) is a section of the *Milindapañha*. Modern translations of the text include an English translation by John Kelly.

A full parallel to the dialogue is preserved in the Chinese translation of the *Milindapañha* tradition at T 1670b 2.18 under the title "Wisdom of the Liberated and that of Ordinary People".
